title: Module 1 — Data collection & validation output
description: Output envelope of 01-data-collection-validation. The `data` payload is the validated, structured RFQ. `status` is `incomplete` when required fields are missing (see missing_fields).

client_config.description: Optional. Passed through by the orchestrator so this module can skip its own Notion lookup. Absent when run standalone.

request_type.description: What the reseller asked Cifral to produce for THIS request. Drives orchestrator routing (falls back to the client's default service_tier when 'unspecified').

scope_of_supply.description: Per-request map of scope-item key (see schemas/scope-catalog.json) -> included boolean. Drives pricing lines, narrative sections, and template blocks together.

custom_fields.description: The client's OWN document variables, declared in the `Fields` tab of their Proposal Config sheet and captured from the RFQ text by label — deterministically, never by the model (modules/proposal/field_capture.js). Keys are the client's own, e.g. `offer_no`. A declared field the sender did not supply is absent here; if it was marked `required` it also appears in missing_fields as `custom_fields.<key>` and the RFQ is `incomplete`.

title.description: The project's own title, as it should read on the cover. Falls back to `type` when the RFQ never names the project.
